selected_defects: V04 aggregate world bounds were 1050 x 580 x 389 mm rather than the project target.
The C-zone gas-sensor group was less legible through the clear enclosure.
Initial V05 GLB included tessellated text and reached 354928 triangles.
The first V05 bounds normalization centred the assembly on Z=0, putting its lower geometry below the physical base datum.
source_repairs: Normalize all model-object transforms against aggregate world bounds.
Anchor the normalized aggregate lower Z bound at 0 m while retaining its X/Y centre and target extents.
Add C-zone sensor backplates, status strips, beacons and a shared rail.
Keep font labels in Blend/render evidence but omit them from runtime GLB export.
limitations: The V05 runtime GLB intentionally omits rendered text meshes; the platform supplies interactive asset labels.
This iteration is a visual and web-asset refinement, not a fabrication drawing or sensor calibration record.
